Build My System — Heuristic Evaluation & Usability Test Findings

Findings combine an expert heuristic evaluation of the Build My System flow across Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet (scored against all 10 Nielsen usability heuristics — evaluators: Gabrielle, Vesna, Rachel, James, and Claude) with a 25-participant unmoderated usability test (13 desktop, 12 mobile). Use the toggle below to view either method alone, or merged into one view.

Data sources: SimpliSafe Build My System heuristic evaluation, FigJam synthesis board (merged issue log — duplicates consolidated, component wording standardized, multi-heuristic issues tagged under every applicable heuristic) and the BMS unmoderated usability test (UserTesting, 13 desktop + 12 mobile participants). Use the Merged / Heuristic Eval / Usability Test toggle above to switch views — findings validated by both methods are tagged with both source badges and include an expandable "usability evidence" note. Severity legend: Major (orange — significant friction), Medium (yellow — moderate usability issue), Minor (green — noticeable but low-impact). Findings tagged with more than one heuristic are counted once in Total Findings but appear in the bar for each heuristic they're tagged under, so heuristic-chart totals may exceed the findings count. Dashboard generated for internal review — refresh by regenerating from the latest synthesis board.
